# miniz

Upstream: https://github.com/richgel999/miniz
Version: 3.0.2 (tag 3.0.2).
License: MIT, copied unchanged to LICENSE and ../../LICENSE_MINIZ.txt.

The amalgamation companion files are the upstream tag sources. miniz_export.h
defines MINIZ_EXPORT as empty for this project's static build. No miniz DLL is
required. Only the diagnostic export worker uses the ZIP writer.
